title: Coffee Cup Horizon
one_liner: Enter what an AI feat costs today and see when it gets cheaper than a cup of coffee.
speaker: Peter Diamandis, citing Noam Brown
context: The hosts discuss the claim that frontier AI results which cost hundreds of thousands of dollars became doable for about $20 within roughly two years, and project the same curve onto this week's multi-million-dollar math result.
demo: A log-scale cost curve that falls toward a 'cup of coffee' line. The visitor picks a preset quoted on the show or enters their own cost and yearly decline factor, and an animated line shows the crossing date. A strip compares several presets side by side.
data_plan: Bundled presets using figures as stated on the podcast, labeled as such; everything else is user input and transparent math.
risks: Figures are podcast claims, not audited data; attribute and label them as illustrative.

episode.title: Should we slow down AI progress? | MOONSHOTS #288
